summary.en: BM25 and dense retrieval in Go, where BM25, exact dense search and fusion are each accepted against a number that Pyserini publishes for BEIR. BM25 equals the published nDCG@10 and Recall@100 to four decimals on six datasets. BGE-base with exact search is within 0.0006 in nDCG@10 on all six, and within 0.0004 on all but TREC-COVID. A pre-registered study on it found that HNSW's loss in nDCG@10 depends on the model at equal ef, and not once each model is searched to the same neighbour recall of 0.95.
summary.zh: 用 Go 实现的 BM25 和稠密检索，其中 BM25、用精确搜索的稠密检索和融合各自对照 Pyserini 为 BEIR 公布的数字验收。BM25 在六个数据集上的 nDCG@10 和 Recall@100 与公布值四位小数相同。BGE-base 加精确搜索在六个数据集上的 nDCG@10 相差都不超过 0.0006，除 TREC-COVID 外不超过 0.0004。在此基础上的一项预注册研究发现：ef 相同时，HNSW 造成的 nDCG@10 损失随模型而变；每个模型都搜索到相同的近邻召回率 0.95 时，就不再随模型而变。

note.en: The anchors are the four-decimal values in Pyserini's `beir.yaml` at one commit, and for fusion the numbers of its BEIR fusion page at that commit. The tolerance of 0.005 in nDCG@10 was fixed for BM25 before any BM25 result existed; for BGE it was committed together with the first BGE results. The BM25 checksums hold on amd64. The BGE, HNSW and fused figures come from one machine; the vectors depend on the CPU in their last bits, so exact values can differ on another. Pyserini's own run files were not compared line by line. Approximate search uses recserve's HNSW graph over the same vectors: at ef 200, 400 and 800, it holds on average at least 0.9912 of a query's exact top 10 on every dataset. Fusing the BM25 and BGE runs as Pyserini does, by RRF and by the sum of min-max normalised scores (Normalize), gives nDCG@10 within 0.005 of Pyserini's published fusion numbers on all six datasets; the largest differences, 0.0036 and 0.0043 above, are on ArguAna. Against the BGE run alone, neither fused run's 95% bootstrap interval lies above zero on any dataset; it lies below zero for RRF on FiQA, ArguAna and SCIDOCS and for Normalize on ArguAna and SCIDOCS. Reranking is not built yet.
note.zh: 锚点是 Pyserini 的 `beir.yaml` 在某一个提交上的四位小数值，融合的锚点是同一提交上它的 BEIR 融合页面的数字。nDCG@10 的容差 0.005，对 BM25 是在任何 BM25 结果出来之前定下的，对 BGE 是和第一批 BGE 结果一起提交的。BM25 的校验和在 amd64 上成立。BGE、HNSW 和融合的数字来自一台机器；向量的末几位取决于 CPU，换一台机器具体数值可能不同。Pyserini 自己的 run 文件没有逐行比过。近似搜索用 recserve 的 HNSW 图，向量相同：在 ef 为 200、400 和 800 时，每个数据集上 HNSW 的前 10 名平均至少包含精确前 10 名中的 0.9912。融合按 Pyserini 的做法把 BM25 和 BGE 的 run 合起来，用 RRF 和 min-max 归一化后相加（Normalize）两种方法，六个数据集上的 nDCG@10 与 Pyserini 公布的融合结果相差都在 0.005 以内；差得最多的是 ArguAna，分别高 0.0036 和 0.0043。和单独的 BGE run 相比，两种融合在任何数据集上的 95% bootstrap 区间都不在零以上；RRF 在 FiQA、ArguAna 和 SCIDOCS 上、Normalize 在 ArguAna 和 SCIDOCS 上，区间整体在零以下。重排还没有做。

problem.en: Two implementations of one BM25 configuration still differ in details of tokenization and stemming, and can differ in stop words, in how title and text are joined, in how the document length is encoded and in how tied scores are ordered.
problem.zh: 同一套 BM25 配置的两个实现，在分词和词干提取的细节上仍然会有差别，在停用词、标题和正文怎么拼接、文档长度怎么编码、同分的结果怎么排序上也可能不同。

problem.en: This project builds its retrieval components in Go. BM25, exact dense search and fusion are each accepted against a published number that a third party can reproduce with public commands and data: the BEIR test sets with fewer than 200,000 documents, and the numbers on Pyserini's BEIR reproducibility page and, for fusion, on its BEIR fusion page. A dataset outside the tolerance is not tuned toward the anchor. Its cause is found and recorded. HNSW is measured against exact search on the same vectors and has no pass threshold.
problem.zh: 这个项目用 Go 实现检索的各个组件。BM25、用精确搜索的稠密检索和融合各自对照一个已公布的数字验收，第三方用公开的命令和数据就能复现：文档数少于 20 万的 BEIR 测试集，以及 Pyserini 的 BEIR 复现页面上的数字，融合用的是它的 BEIR 融合页面上的数字。超出容差的数据集不朝着锚点去调，要找到原因并记录下来。HNSW 对照同一批向量上的精确搜索来度量，不设通过阈值。

problem.en: Done so far: the evaluation harness, BM25, dense retrieval with exact search and with recserve's HNSW graph, and fusion of the BM25 and BGE runs. Cross-encoder reranking is not built yet.
problem.zh: 目前做完的有：评测台、BM25，用精确搜索和用 recserve 的 HNSW 图做的稠密检索，以及 BM25 与 BGE 两路 run 的融合。交叉编码器重排还没有做。

problem.en: On this harness a pre-registered study compared eight embedding models on seven BEIR datasets, searching four HNSW graphs per model and dataset. A model's loss is its nDCG@10 under exact search minus that under HNSW, and a difference below 0.005 counts as negligible. At equal search parameters, ef 40, the loss depends on the model (H1 supported): averaged over the datasets it runs from 0.0040 to 0.0193, and the registered test separates 19 of the 28 pairs of models, 8 of them by more than 0.005. With each graph searched at the smallest ef that finds 0.95 of the exact top 10, it does not (H2 supported): on the six datasets where every model can be matched to that recall within 0.01, the test separates no pair and the 90% interval of the spread between models ends at 0.0047, while each model loses 0.0101 to 0.0120. There HNSW keeps the exact-search order (H3 supported): of the 21 pairs that exact search orders, none is reversed and one is left unordered. At the recall-0.95 setting the build alone moves a model's nDCG@10 on a dataset by 0.005 or more in 15 of 49 cases, by up to 0.0203 across four builds (H4 not supported). Fusing with BM25 by RRF at ef 100 removes 0.24 of the loss, with a 95% interval of 0.16 to 0.33, short of the half that H5 required (not supported).
problem.zh: 在这套评测台上，一项预注册研究比较了 8 个嵌入模型在 7 个 BEIR 数据集上的表现，每个模型和数据集各搜索 4 张 HNSW 图。模型的损失是精确搜索的 nDCG@10 减去 HNSW 的 nDCG@10，差距小于 0.005 视为可以忽略。搜索参数相同（ef 都是 40）时，损失随模型而变（H1 成立）：按数据集平均，从 0.0040 到 0.0193；登记的检验在 28 对模型中分出了 19 对，其中 8 对相差超过 0.005。每张图都用能找回精确前 10 名中 0.95 的最小 ef 搜索时，损失不再随模型而变（H2 成立）：在每个模型的召回率都能对齐到 0.95（相差不超过 0.01）的 6 个数据集上，检验分不出任何一对模型，模型间极差的 90% 区间上端是 0.0047，而每个模型的损失在 0.0101 到 0.0120 之间。在这一召回率下，HNSW 保持精确搜索给出的模型顺序（H3 成立）：精确搜索分得出先后的 21 对里，没有一对颠倒，有一对分不出先后。在召回率 0.95 的设置下，单是建图这一项，就让某个模型在某个数据集上的 nDCG@10 在 49 种情形中的 15 种里变动 0.005 或更多，4 次建图之间最多相差 0.0203（H4 不成立）。在 ef 为 100 时用 RRF 与 BM25 融合，消除了损失中的 0.24，95% 区间 0.16 到 0.33，不到 H5 要求的一半（不成立）。

dataSub.zh: 六个测试集，按 SHA-256 校验

bm25Sub.zh: Bleve 的索引，Lucene 的打分

evalSub.zh: 按 trec_eval 的规则，逐查询

vectorsSub.zh: 与 Pyserini 索引里的向量算余弦

description.en: `scripts/data.sh` downloads the six BEIR datasets and checks them by SHA-256. `cmd/bm25` indexes the title and text of each document with Bleve and ranks the test queries with Lucene's BM25, computed from Bleve's postings. `cmd/embed` encodes each corpus with BGE-base-en-v1.5 on ONNX Runtime, and `cmd/dense` encodes the queries and searches every vector. `cmd/bm25` and `cmd/dense` each write a TREC run file of the top 1000 per query. `cmd/eval` scores a run as `trec_eval -c` does, and `scripts/check-eval.sh` compares its output with trec_eval v10.0 as text. `cmd/table` computes the metric tables from the run files and sets each figure beside Pyserini's published value; with `-dense` it also compares each document vector of SciFact, NFCorpus and ArguAna with the one in Pyserini's prebuilt index.
description.zh: `scripts/data.sh` 下载六个 BEIR 数据集并按 SHA-256 校验。`cmd/bm25` 用 Bleve 给每篇文档的标题和正文建索引，再用 Lucene 的 BM25 公式在 Bleve 的倒排表上为测试查询排出结果。`cmd/embed` 用 ONNX Runtime 上的 BGE-base-en-v1.5 编码每个语料，`cmd/dense` 编码查询并与每个向量比较。`cmd/bm25` 和 `cmd/dense` 各自写出每个查询前 1000 名的 TREC run 文件。`cmd/eval` 按 `trec_eval -c` 的规则给 run 文件打分，`scripts/check-eval.sh` 把它的输出与 trec_eval v10.0 的输出按文本比较。`cmd/table` 从 run 文件算出指标表，把每个数字排在 Pyserini 公布的数值旁边；加上 `-dense` 时，它还把 SciFact、NFCorpus 和 ArguAna 每篇文档的向量与 Pyserini 预建索引里的向量比较。

title.en: The anchors and the tolerance come first

body.en: The anchors are the BM25 values in Pyserini's `beir.yaml` at one commit, to four decimals. The tolerance is 0.005 in nDCG@10 per dataset, fixed before any BM25 result existed: two implementations of one configuration differ in details of tokenization and stemming, which should move nDCG@10 far less than a change of method does.
body.zh: 锚点是 Pyserini 的 `beir.yaml` 在某一个提交上的 BM25 数值，取四位小数。容差是每个数据集 nDCG@10 相差不超过 0.005，在任何 BM25 结果出来之前定下：同一套配置的两个实现在分词和词干提取的细节上会有差别，但它对 nDCG@10 的影响应该远小于换一种方法。

title.en: Metrics in Go, checked against trec_eval
title.zh: 指标用 Go 实现，对照 trec_eval 检查

body.en: The anchors are trec_eval numbers, so its rules decide ties, grades and which queries count. The metrics are written in Go, and trec_eval v10.0 is built from source only to check them: a script compares the per-query output of the two as text. Owning the code keeps a C binary out of the pipeline, and the check keeps the code honest.
body.zh: 锚点是 trec_eval 算出的数字，所以同分怎么排、相关度等级怎么算、哪些查询计入，都按它的规则。指标用 Go 实现，trec_eval v10.0 只为检查而从源码编译：一个脚本把两者的逐查询输出按文本比较。代码在自己手里，流水线里就不必带一个 C 程序；有这项检查，代码就不会走样。

title.en: Bleve holds the index; the scoring is Lucene's
title.zh: 索引用 Bleve，打分用 Lucene 的公式

body.en: Bleve does the analysis and holds the inverted index. The score is a port of Lucene's `BM25Similarity`, computed from Bleve's postings, with Lucene's lossy one-byte encoding of the document length. In v2.6.3 Bleve's own BM25 differs from Lucene's in five ways: among them, it takes the square root of the term frequency, and its average length is built from per-segment counts of distinct terms, not from lengths, so it changes when segments merge.
body.zh: Bleve 负责分析文本并保存倒排索引。分数是移植过来的 Lucene `BM25Similarity`，在 Bleve 的倒排表上计算，文档长度用 Lucene 那种有损的单字节编码。在 v2.6.3 里，Bleve 自带的 BM25 与 Lucene 的有五处不同，其中两处：它对词频取平方根；它的平均长度由各段里不同词项的个数算出，不是由长度算出，所以段合并时会变。

title.en: Document text and length, read off Pyserini's vectors
title.zh: 文档文本和长度，从 Pyserini 的向量上读出来

body.en: Pyserini publishes no encoding command for its prebuilt BGE indexes, and its own encoder defaults to 256 tokens. Its indexes hold the document vectors, so the choice was read off them: title and text joined by a space, at most 512 tokens, gave cosines of at least 0.999999 on the first 160 SciFact documents, where 256 tokens gave a lowest of 0.960.
body.zh: Pyserini 没有公布它预建的 BGE 索引是用什么命令编码的，它自己的编码器默认是 256 个 token。它的索引里存着文档向量，所以选择是从向量上读出来的：标题和正文用空格拼接、最多 512 个 token，在 SciFact 的前 160 篇文档上余弦都不低于 0.999999；256 个 token 时最低是 0.960。

title.en: CI checks the dense results by tolerance, not by checksum
title.zh: CI 按容差检查稠密检索的结果，不用校验和

body.en: ONNX Runtime chooses its kernels by the CPU's instruction set, so vectors can differ in their last bits from one machine to another, and a checksum would fail on another runner with nothing wrong. On every push CI encodes NFCorpus and fails if nDCG@10 is more than 0.005 from the anchor or if any document vector has a cosine below 0.9999 to Pyserini's.
body.zh: ONNX Runtime 按 CPU 的指令集选择计算内核，所以不同机器上的向量在末几位可能不同，换一台机器校验和就会无故失败。每次推送，CI 编码 NFCorpus，只要 nDCG@10 与锚点相差超过 0.005，或者有文档向量与 Pyserini 的余弦低于 0.9999，就判失败。

title.en: Bleve's BM25 is not Lucene's, and varies between builds
title.zh: Bleve 的 BM25 和 Lucene 的不一样，两次建索引的结果也不一样

body.en: With k1 and b set alike, Bleve's own scorer is 0.243 below the anchor on TREC-COVID and 0.148 above it on ArguAna. Its run files also differ between two builds of the same index, even merged into one segment: on five of the six datasets in the pair of builds behind the table, and in a rerun ArguAna's nDCG@10 came out 0.5448 and 0.5442. The cause was not investigated. These runs are a reference, not this project's retrieval path, and are not checked in CI.
body.zh: k1 和 b 设成相同时，Bleve 自带的打分器在 TREC-COVID 上比锚点低 0.243，在 ArguAna 上高 0.148。同一份数据建两次索引，即使都合并成单段，它的 run 文件也不相同：结果表所用的那一对索引里，六个数据集有五个如此，重跑时 ArguAna 的 nDCG@10 分别是 0.5448 和 0.5442。原因没有查。这些运行只作参考，本项目的检索不走这条路，也不进 CI。

title.en: A logarithm one unit in the last place lower
title.zh: 对数低了一个末位单位

body.en: Go's `math.Log2` is one unit in the last place lower than C's for 3 and 9, which can move the fourth decimal trec_eval prints. The discounts of ranks 1 to 10 are therefore C's correctly rounded values. Beyond rank 10 they still come from `math.Log2`, so nDCG@k for k above 10 can differ from trec_eval in the fourth decimal in rare cases.
body.zh: 对 3 和 9，Go 的 `math.Log2` 比 C 的结果低一个末位单位，这可能改变 trec_eval 打印的第四位小数。所以第 1 到 10 名的折扣用的是 C 那边正确舍入的值。第 10 名之后的折扣仍然来自 `math.Log2`，所以 k 大于 10 的 nDCG@k 在少数情况下可能与 trec_eval 在第四位小数上不同。

title.en: Twenty-eight documents with characters nobody sees
title.zh: 28 篇文档里有看不见的字符

body.en: With the document encoding settled, 28 documents of SciFact and ArguAna still had a cosine below 0.9999 to Pyserini's vector, and every one held soft hyphens, zero-width spaces or left-to-right marks. Hugging Face's BERT normalizer, which Pyserini's encoder uses, removes such characters; the Go tokenizer library removes only control characters. Documents now lose every character of Unicode category C but tab, newline and carriage return before encoding. Queries keep format characters, as the anchor's query tokenizer does.
body.zh: 文档的编码方式定下之后，SciFact 和 ArguAna 仍有 28 篇与 Pyserini 向量的余弦低于 0.9999，每一篇都含有软连字符、零宽空格或从左到右标记。Pyserini 的编码器用的 Hugging Face BERT 规范化器会删掉这类字符；Go 的分词库只删控制字符。现在文档在编码前先删掉 Unicode C 类的所有字符，制表符、换行和回车除外。查询保留格式字符，和锚点的查询分词器一样。

body.en: The study covers one HNSW implementation, corpora of up to 2.7 million documents, English text and these eight models. It does not report latency: equal ef means equal search parameters, not equal cost. The spread of four builds understates that of all builds. The vectors are not archived, so a rerun encodes again and its graphs and runs differ in detail. BEIR's judgements are sparse, and a document nobody judged counts as not relevant.
body.zh: 研究只涉及一种 HNSW 实现、文档数不超过 270 万的语料、英文文本和这 8 个模型。它不报告延迟：ef 相同只是搜索参数相同，并不意味着开销相同。4 次建图之间的差距会低估所有可能建图之间的差距。向量没有存档，重跑需要重新编码，建出的图和 run 在细节上会不同。BEIR 的相关性标注是稀疏的，没人标注过的文档按不相关计。
